78: Jason's chapter 1 safehouse, owned by Brian. Renovate it before Lucia comes home, meditate on the balcony and read 4 magazines here. Warning: you lose the house for good after Tourist Trap.
106: The bar from Coming Home and Day Release: the party after Lucia gets out of prison, a live band and a brawl.
107: Brian Heder's marina – the start of Down to Earth and Swamped. Brian's stash is the first fence in the game (after Lab Fees), but he pays very little.
111: The 24/7 store in Key Lento. One of the collectible magazines (RX Men) sits on the newspaper rack.
239: The community center where Lucia works. In Clock Out, pick her up before 4 PM – it improves the couple's relationship.
80: The radar station on Maroon Key – where Hey Arnold! with Brian and Cal takes place, with a choice at the end.
214: Leonida Penitentiary in Hamlet. The prologue starts here (you play as Lucia), and Jason picks her up here in Coming Home.
664: The Payday Loan in Hamlet – one of the prologue locations. Later, Payday Loans are robbery targets (7 needed for 100%).
94: Starlet Motel – the chapter 2 safehouse. East of here, the UFO appears at 2:00 AM (trophy "The Truth is Out There").
165: Thrillbilly Mud Club – Billy's storyline starts here (Thrillbillies). 10 wins here, at Gellhorn Raceway and Boone Speedway unlock the vehicle repair cheat.
87: Gellhorn International Raceway – a race track modeled on Sebring. One of three tracks that count toward the vehicle repair cheat.
188: Ambrosia Raceway – demolition derby. A win pays about $3,800–6,300, and you can rent a car for a few hundred dollars.
89: Pawn & Gun in Port Gellhorn – buy weapons and ammo here.
197: Delights club by the interstate. North of it, near Moses' workshop, is the free Port Gellhorn Station garage (after Daily Driver).
131: The Allied Crystal sugar mill – Ambrosia's only big employer. The rest of the town is run by the Final Chapter biker gang.
173: Leaf Links – a full golf course in Vice Beach (Leaf Links Golf Challenge).
895: Jacob's Tavern in Millport – a bar with pool next to a Pay 'n' Spray. There's also a book about a New Austin cowboy here, a nod to Red Dead Redemption.
183: The Vault club in Downtown. Scanning the red poster just inside the entrance unlocks The Vault station on the radio.
66: Grand Majestic in Tequesta. A trading card lies in the kitchen on the gym floor, and another one on the neighboring rooftop (take the elevator).
112: Vice City International Airport (VCIA). The Catch Me If You Can trophy requires an unscheduled departure from here.
320: Phil's Ammu-Nation – the gun store of Phil, a new take on Phil Cassidy from Vice City. Every Ammu-Nation has a locker with your weapons.
171: The summit of Mount Kalaga – a stone circle with the final, 18th meditation (Ascent Mountain). It unlocks after all the others.
363: Manifest Canyon – red rocks with the Red Rocks meditation, near where the train tracks cross the highway.
629: Lake Tallaloko. Northwest of here, above a waterfall, is the Waterfall meditation.
825: Belville in Leonard County. The house from the GTA San Andreas photo stands in this area – its garage hides a conspiracy theorist's den with notes about "J" and "L".
33: Evergreen Mall in Waning Sands. Nearby are Frontier Adventure Golf, the Mount Hailes Club course and the Seaside meditation on the beach to the east.
26: Vice Beach Marina in Ocean Beach. Supercars from Randy's list are most often parked by the hotels in this part of town.
500: The casino in Buckskin. Nearby, along the road through Buckskin Swamp, are the Kowaachobee bar with pool, King Gator mini golf and the Swamp meditation.
918: Gambit Bay – the easiest place to meet Cool Dog. Get stranded at sea without a boat, climb onto his jet ski and stay on: he takes you to Dog Island (about $1,200).
917: Pelican River in the Mariana County swamps – Kirk's Skunk Ape (Bigfoot) missions and the Find the Lost Drugs task. Alligators bask here.
196: Grassrivers Visitor Center – the gateway to the swamps. Use an airboat or hovercraft to get around the canals.
